blurb: The Gladstone Park Conference Center is an 80+ acre campus in Gladstone, Oregon to serve our Oregon Conference ministries. The big event that happens here every July is Gladstone Camp Meeting. The campus offers several buildings such as the Holden Convention Center which can seat up to 500 in the main hall. There are also two breakout rooms downstairs that can be further divided to make a total of four rooms.
